goldHistory._why: Standalone, at March. The FY13-FY15 episode is the closest precedent for a gold-price fall: RBI capped LTV at 60% (2012, relaxed to 75% in Jan-2014) while gold fell; the loan book shrank for five quarters.

subsidiaries.note: Group AUM = sum less ₹3,890 cr of loans from the parent to Muthoot Money. Muthoot Money received ₹1,000 cr of fresh equity from the parent in FY26. AAF in INR at 0.2808 INR/LKR (Jun-26) and 0.3008 (FY26). Subsidiaries were 12% of group AUM and ~10% of group profit in Q1FY27.

guidance.aumGrowthFy27: 15% (standalone, from Mar-26; to be revised after Q2)
guidance.costOfBorrowing: no reductions expected; could rise with RBI rates
guidance.branchesFy27: 500-600 for the group (200-250 standalone; ~200 Belstar gold branches)
guidance.midTermRoa: ~3.5% long-run ROA guidance (CFO, Q4 call: 'we always used to give a guidance of a median term ROI of around 3.5%')
guidance.profit: no profit guidance ('profits are secondary for us')

regulation.ltvTiers: 85% up to ₹2.5 lakh, 80% ₹2.5-5 lakh, 75% above ₹5 lakh (consumption loans, per borrower, through the tenor)
regulation.bullet: bullet loans capped at 12 months; LTV includes all interest due at maturity; renewal only after paying accrued interest
regulation.valuation: lower of 30-day average and previous-day close of the purity-specific price (IBJA or a SEBI-regulated exchange)
regulation.limits: 1 kg gold ornaments and 50 g gold coins per borrower
regulation.auction: reserve price ≥ 90% of current value (85% after two failed auctions); two newspaper notices; surplus refunded within 7 working days
regulation.release: collateral returned within 7 working days of repayment, else ₹5,000 a day compensation

governance.auditors: Krishnamoorthy & Krishnamoorthy and PSDY & Associates (joint statutory auditors, appointed at the 27th AGM to the 30th AGM in 2027)
governance.promoterPay: Chairman, MD, two whole-time directors each paid 766x the median employee (+10% in FY26); three next-generation whole-time directors 201x (+199%); median employee pay +14.22%
governance.board: 7 promoter-family executives (chairman George Jacob Muthoot, MD George Alexander Muthoot) and 7-8 independent directors
governance.relatedParty: Some branch premises are rented from or were acquired from promoter-family members (AR title-deed schedule); parent lends to Muthoot Money (₹3,890 cr outstanding Mar-26)
